title: Gloss-Free Representation Learning for Cross-Dataset Sign Spotting
abstract: arXiv:2608.11332v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sign-language research for resource-constrained languages is often limited by the cost of dense linguistic labels such as glosses, temporal boundaries, and sign order. Broadcast news offers a practical alternative by pairing continuous signing with spoken-language transcripts, but this supervision is weak since text and signing are loosely aligned. Morphologically rich languages such as Turkish add further difficulty, as the same lexical meaning can appear in many inflected forms while some derived forms should remain distinct. We study whether weak transcript-based supervision can pretrain a reusable sign encoder in this setting, where poor text normalization can fragment pseudo-gloss targets and weaken representation learning. Unlike prior pseudo-gloss pipelines designed mainly to improve translation, we test whether the pretrained encoder transfers as a reusable representation for cross-dataset sign spotting. translated_title: 无注释标签的跨数据集手语识别表示学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.11332v1 公告类型：新 摘要：对于资源受限语言的手语研究，常常受到密集语言标签（如注释标签、时间边界和手语顺序）成本的限制。新闻广播提供了一种实用替代方案，通过将连续手语与口语转录配对，但这种监督较弱，因为文本和手语之间的对齐松散。诸如土耳其语等形态丰富的语言增加了进一步难度，因为相同的词汇意义可能以多种屈折形式出现，而某些派生形式应保持区别。我们研究在这种设置下，弱转录监督是否能够预训练一个可重用的手语编码器，其中较差的文本规范化可能碎片化伪注释目标并削弱表示学习。与主要旨在改进翻译的先前伪注释流程不同，我们测试预训练编码器是否作为可重用表示转移到跨数据集手语识别中。我们在TSL-News上预训练。
tldr: 本文提出在弱转录监督下预训练可重用的手语编码器，无需注释标签，并在跨数据集手语识别任务中验证其迁移能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes pretraining a reusable sign encoder under weak transcript supervision without glosses, and validates its transferability for cross-dataset sign spotting.
